notes.subject: Aug. 6, 2026 inbound quote request — Pirate's Rebellion for July 23–25, 2027
notes.body: The Town of Langford Finance Office asked for a quote for Pirate's Rebellion for tentative dates July 23–25, 2027. They saw the bumper boat setup in Forman, ND and said it appeared to be a hit. This is a warm inbound lead and needs a direct reply. Gmail message/thread 19fd83502c1a9820.

notes.subject: UNSENT EMAIL DRAFT — Langford Pirate's Rebellion quote
notes.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reaching out—and I’m so glad you had a chance to see Pirate’s Rebellion in Forman!

For your tentative July 23–25, 2027 dates, Pirate’s Rebellion is $7,500 for up to four days. We provide the attractions, complete setup and teardown, staffing and supervision throughout the event, and the required certificate of insurance.

Those dates are tentative on your end, so please let me know what information you need from us to continue planning. We would love to bring Pirate’s Rebellion to Langford next summer.

Take care,
Desiree
The Adventure Zone

followUps.label: Send Langford 2027 Pirate's Rebellion quote
followUps.reason: Warm inbound quote request has not received a reply. Send the prepared quote and confirm tentative July 23–25, 2027 dates.

notes.subject: Future fit option — Mini Zone for smaller footprint
notes.body: The 2026 rejection was specifically about the full Adventure Zone footprint. For a future year, offer the Mini Zone instead: five attractions in roughly 3,000–5,000 square feet. Only pursue if the organizer is open to a compact family area; do not repeat the full-zone pitch.

notes.subject: UNSENT EMAIL DRAFT — Helper Arts Festival Mini Zone
notes.body:
Hi,

Thank you for letting us know. I completely understand that the full Adventure Zone setup is too large for your festival area.

For future events, we do have a smaller Mini Zone option with five attractions that can fit in roughly 3,000–5,000 square feet. If that smaller footprint might work with a future layout, I’d love to reconnect early next year and see whether there is a good fit.

I hope this year’s festival went wonderfully!

Take care,
Desiree
The Adventure Zone
